items.quote: and sent him away to Padanaram, to take him a wife from thence
items.claim: Isaac sent Jacob to Padanaram to take a wife

items.quote: as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan
items.claim: Isaac charged Jacob not to marry daughters of Canaan

items.quote: Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padanaram
items.claim: Jacob obeyed his parents and went to Padanaram

items.quote: the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father
items.claim: Canaanite daughters did not please Isaac

items.quote: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife
items.claim: Esau took Mahalath, daughter of Ishmael, to be his wife
